code='''def transform(grid):
    """Draw a color-2 rectangle around the bounding box of non-background cells."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    if not pts:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            if r in (r0, r1) or c in (c0, c1):
                if out[r][c] == bg:
                    out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
